correctness.rationale: The 2nd and 4th isotropic weighted-ball moments produce the displayed exact degree-two reproducing kernel: constants + D<x,y> + D(D+2)/2[(x·y)^2-||x||^2||y||^2/d] + D^2(D+2)/(4dk)(||x||^2-d/D)(||y||^2-d/D), D=d+2k. Radial squared norm has Beta(d/2,k) law; d(1-R_d^2)/2→Gamma(k) in L1 and normalized angular coordinate→N(0,1) independently. Uniform in radius, the kernel divided by d tends in L1 to one-half the absolute value of (1-r²)(G/k-1)+r²(Z²-1). The limiting profile is strictly convex on interior: its maximum is at r=0 or 1 only, even at the tie. Endpoints integrate to k^k e^-k/Gamma(k+1) and sqrt(2/(pi e)), equal at k=1/2; the gamma centered absolute deviation decreases strictly with k by gamma/Beta conditional Jensen. Independent symbolic moment-reproduction and representative finite-weight checks supported normalization. Limit is only for fixed k>0; no finite-d exact maximizer is claimed.
